gero-cross.title: The Gero Cross
gero-cross.description: The earliest surviving large monumental crucifix in the West, this wooden sculpture dares to show Christ already dead, his body sagging from suffering.
descriptions: Carved around 970 in Cologne under Archbishop Gero
Christ figure in oak wood, 2.87 meters tall
First large Western crucifix depicting the dead Christ
Still displayed in Cologne Cathedral in Germany
Changes how Christ is shown in medieval art

bayeux-tapestry.title: The Bayeux Tapestry
bayeux-tapestry.description: Nearly seventy meters long, this embroidery tells the story of William the Conqueror's conquest of England, like an 11th-century comic strip.
descriptions: Embroidered around 1070 by Anglo-Saxon artisans
Linen strip 70 meters long and 50 cm tall
Tells the Battle of Hastings and the 1066 Norman conquest
Preserved at the Bayeux Tapestry Museum in Normandy
Inscribed on UNESCO's Memory of the World Register in 2007

taull-pantocrator.title: Pantocrator of Taüll
taull-pantocrator.artistFullName: Master of Sant Climent de Taüll
taull-pantocrator.description: A pinnacle of Catalan Romanesque fresco, this hieratic Christ in Majesty was detached from its Pyrenean church to be moved to a museum.
descriptions: Painted around 1123 in the church of Sant Climent de Taüll
Wall fresco detached from its Pyrenean church in 1919
Christ in majesty surrounded by Alpha and Omega, symbols of eternity
Preserved at the National Art Museum of Catalonia in Barcelona
Peak of Catalan Romanesque art, listed as UNESCO heritage

vladimir-virgin.title: Virgin of Vladimir
vladimir-virgin.description: A Byzantine icon venerated as the protector of Russia, where the Virgin presses her cheek against the Child's.
descriptions: Byzantine icon painted in Constantinople in the 12th century
Tempera on wood, the classic technique of Orthodox icons
Brought to Kiev in 1131 then transferred to Vladimir in 1155
Preserved at the Tretyakov Gallery in Moscow since 1930
Venerated as the holy protector of Russia

autun-last-judgment.title: The Last Judgment of Autun
autun-last-judgment.description: This Romanesque tympanum teeming with terrified damned bears a rare medieval signature: 'Gislebertus made me.'
descriptions: Carved between 1130 and 1146 by Gislebertus
Stone tympanum located above the main door
Bears the rare medieval signature 'Gislebertus hoc fecit'
Visible at Saint-Lazare Cathedral in Autun, Burgundy
Covered in plaster in the 18th century, which saved it from destruction

monreale-pantocrator.title: Christ Pantocrator of Monreale
monreale-pantocrator.description: A massive gold-ground mosaic dominating the apse of a Sicilian cathedral, this blessing Christ with outstretched arms is visible from the entire nave.
descriptions: Byzantine mosaic created around 1180 under William II of Sicily
Covers the apse with millions of molten gold tesserae
Christ's face alone measures over 7 meters tall
Still visible in Monreale Cathedral near Palermo
The set covers 6,340 m² of mosaics, among the largest in the world

pisa-pulpit.title: Pisa Baptistery Pulpit
pisa-pulpit.description: Nicola Pisano's first great carved pulpit draws on ancient sarcophagi and already foreshadows Renaissance sculpture.
descriptions: Sculpted by Nicola Pisano between 1259 and 1260
Hexagonal marble pulpit supported by columns
Inspired by ancient Roman sarcophagi that Pisano studied
Located in Pisa Baptistery, near the famous leaning tower
Considered the birth certificate of Italian sculpture

deesis-hagia-sophia.title: Deësis of Hagia Sophia
deesis-hagia-sophia.description: This mosaic showing Christ between the Virgin and Saint John reaches, through the gentleness of its faces, the apex of Byzantine art.
descriptions: Created around 1261 after the Byzantine reconquest of Constantinople
Gold mosaic depicting Christ between Mary and John the Baptist
Partially destroyed, the lower part disappeared over the centuries
Visible at Hagia Sophia in Istanbul, a UNESCO site
Considered the peak of the second Byzantine golden age

bamberg-rider.title: The Bamberg Horseman
bamberg-rider.description: The first monumental equestrian statue carved since antiquity, this idealized king represents the knight of the Germanic Middle Ages.
descriptions: Carved around 1235 in the Gothic cathedral of Bamberg
Sandstone equestrian statue, the first of its kind since Antiquity
The rider's identity is still debated: Hungarian or Germanic king
Preserved at Saint Peter and Saint George Cathedral in Bamberg
City listed as UNESCO World Heritage since 1993

naumburg-uta.title: Uta of Naumburg
naumburg-uta.description: A statue of a donor who had died two centuries earlier, Uta is admired as one of the most beautiful faces in Gothic sculpture.
descriptions: Carved around 1245 by the anonymous Master of Naumburg
Polychrome stone statue 1.80 meters tall
Depicts Uta of Ballenstedt, a benefactor who died two centuries earlier
Still visible in the west choir of Naumburg Cathedral
Said to have inspired the evil queen in Disney's Snow White

rucellai-madonna.title: Rucellai Madonna
rucellai-madonna.description: The largest painted panel of the 13th century, this Virgin enchants through the Gothic elegance of her gold-trimmed drapery.
descriptions: Painted by Duccio between 1285 and 1286 for the Rucellai family
Tempera on wood, 4.5 meters tall, a colossal panel
Virgin's blue drapery enhanced with lines of pure gold
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Long attributed to Cimabue before its author was identified

cimabue-maesta.title: Santa Trinita Maestà
cimabue-maesta.artistFullName: Cenni di Pepo, known as Cimabue
cimabue-maesta.description: Presumed master of Giotto, Cimabue paints a monumental Virgin in Majesty where Byzantine rigor gradually opens to emotion.
descriptions: Painted around 1280-1285 for the church of Santa Trinita in Florence
Tempera and gold on wood, an altarpiece 3.8 meters tall
Cimabue was reputedly Giotto's master, having discovered him as a shepherd
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Marks the transition between Byzantine art and Italian naturalism

giotto-lamentation.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ
giotto-lamentation.description: Giotto revolutionizes painting by lending real emotions to his figures: here, even the angels of heaven writhe with grief.
descriptions: Painted by Giotto around 1305 in the Scrovegni Chapel
Lime fresco measuring about 2 meters by 2
The angels painted in the sky weep and writhe in pain
Visible in the Scrovegni Chapel in Padua, Italy
Considered the birth certificate of modern painting

giotto-kiss-judas.title: Kiss of Judas
giotto-kiss-judas.description: At the heart of a tense scrum, Judas wraps Christ in his yellow cloak; their meeting gazes freeze the moment of betrayal.
descriptions: Painted between 1303 and 1305 in the Scrovegni Chapel
Fresco in which Judas, in a yellow cloak, kisses Christ to betray him
Composition centered on the dramatic face-to-face of the two figures
Visible in Padua, in the Life of Christ cycle
The yellow cloak traditionally symbolizes treachery

giotto-ognissanti.title: Ognissanti Madonna
giotto-ognissanti.description: Displayed near the Virgins of Cimabue and Duccio, this Madonna enthroned in space reveals Giotto's new sense of volume.
descriptions: Painted around 1310 for the church of Ognissanti in Florence
Tempera on wood, monumental altarpiece 3.25 meters tall
Enthroned Virgin depicted with real three-dimensional volume
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Displayed near the Madonnas of Cimabue and Duccio for comparison

duccio-maesta.title: Maestà by Duccio
duccio-maesta.description: A monumental altarpiece carried in procession through Siena on the day of its installation, it confirms Duccio as master of the Sienese school.
descriptions: Painted by Duccio between 1308 and 1311 for Siena Cathedral
Double-sided altarpiece over 5 meters wide with 60 panels
Carried in procession through Siena during its installation
Preserved at the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo in Siena
Dismembered in the 18th century, some panels are now abroad

guidoriccio.title: Guidoriccio da Fogliano
guidoriccio.description: This condottiere riding alone through a desolate landscape is among the first secular equestrian portraits in Western art.
descriptions: Painted by Simone Martini in 1330 according to tradition
Fresco depicting a condottiero riding through a desolate landscape
Among the first secular equestrian portraits in Western art
Visible at the Public Palace of Siena, in the Hall of the World Map
Its attribution to Simone Martini is now debated by historians

martini-annunciation.title: The Annunciation
martini-annunciation.description: Against a precious gold ground, the Virgin pulls back gracefully from the angel Gabriel: a pinnacle of Sienese courtly Gothic.
descriptions: Painted in 1333 by Simone Martini with his brother-in-law Lippo Memmi
Tempera and gold on wood, altarpiece intended for Siena Cathedral
Gold background and Gothic draperies with refined curves
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Marks the peak of the courtly Sienese Gothic style

good-government.title: Allegory of Good Government
good-government.description: A vast political fresco contrasting the effects of good and bad government on town and countryside — a true civic manifesto.
descriptions: Painted by Ambrogio Lorenzetti between 1338 and 1339
Fresco cycle covering the walls of the Hall of the Nine
First major political work in Western painting
Visible at the Public Palace of Siena, Italy
Features the first panoramic view of a real medieval city

birth-virgin-lorenzetti.title: Birth of the Virgin
birth-virgin-lorenzetti.description: Pietro Lorenzetti makes the panels of his altarpiece converse with painted architecture, creating the illusion of a real chamber.
descriptions: Painted by Pietro Lorenzetti in 1342 for Siena Cathedral
Tempera on wood, triptych whose panels engage in dialogue
Creates the illusion of a real continuous room behind the columns
Preserved at the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo in Siena
Pietro likely died of the Black Death in 1348

wilton-diptych.title: The Wilton Diptych
wilton-diptych.description: A portable altar of King Richard II of England, this diptych shows him being presented to the Virgin by his patron saints against brilliant ultramarine blue.
descriptions: Painted around 1395-1399 for King Richard II of England
Small portable oak altar measuring 53 x 37 cm
Blue background made from crushed lapis lazuli, a precious pigment
Preserved at the National Gallery in London since 1929
Its author remains unknown, debated between English and French masters

monaco-coronation.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
monaco-coronation.artistFullName: Piero di Giovanni, known as Lorenzo Monaco
monaco-coronation.description: Painted by a Camaldolese monk, this vast altarpiece with vivid colors and flowing lines is a peak of Florentine Late Gothic.
descriptions: Painted by Lorenzo Monaco in 1414 for the monastery of Santa Maria degli Angeli
Tempera and gold on wood, monumental altarpiece
Created by a Camaldolese monk, an Italian contemplative order
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Peak of late Florentine Gothic before the Renaissance arrived

tres-riches-heures.title: Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry
tres-riches-heures.artistFullName: Paul, Jean and Herman de Limbourg
tres-riches-heures.description: The most famous illuminated book of hours: its calendars detailing the labors of the months offer a striking picture of medieval life.
descriptions: Illuminated by the Limbourg brothers between 1411 and 1416
Book of hours with 206 parchment folios
Calendar illustrating the labors of the months and medieval daily life
Preserved at the Musée Condé in Chantilly, where it never leaves
Left unfinished after its authors died in the 1416 plague

rublev-trinity.title: The Trinity
rublev-trinity.description: A masterpiece of the Russian icon, this Trinity depicts three angels with gestures of silent harmony around a single cup.
descriptions: Painted by Andrei Rublev around 1411-1425
Tempera icon on wood measuring 142 x 114 cm
Depicts three angels visiting Abraham according to Genesis
Preserved at the Tretyakov Gallery in Moscow since 1929
Considered the peak of the Russian Orthodox icon

adoration-magi-gentile.title: Adoration of the Magi
adoration-magi-gentile.description: A pinnacle of International Gothic, this altarpiece teems with gold brocades and an exotic procession, commissioned by a wealthy Florentine banker.
descriptions: Painted by Gentile da Fabriano in 1423 for Palla Strozzi
Tempera and gold on wood, altarpiece 3 meters tall
Commissioned by the richest banker in Florence
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Peak of International Gothic painting

tribute-money.title: The Tribute Money
tribute-money.artistFullName: Tommaso di Ser Giovanni, known as Masaccio
tribute-money.description: Masaccio applies perspective and natural light to a gospel scene, paving the way for all Renaissance painting.
descriptions: Painted by Masaccio around 1425 in the Brancacci Chapel
First fresco to apply scientific perspective
Natural light comes from the same direction as the real window
Visible in the Brancacci Chapel of the Carmine church in Florence
Masaccio died at 26, shortly after this revolutionary work

battle-san-romano.title: The Battle of San Romano
battle-san-romano.description: This battle with lances raised like geometry is one of the first great attempts at perspective applied to a scene of movement.
descriptions: Painted by Paolo Uccello around 1438-1440 for the Medici
Triptych whose panels are now in three different museums
Raised lances forming geometric perspective lines
The central panel is at the National Gallery in London
Uccello was nicknamed 'the one who thinks only of perspective'

vision-st-eustace.title: The Vision of Saint Eustace
vision-st-eustace.description: In a forest filled with animals observed with a naturalist's precision, the hunter Eustace glimpses a crucifix between a stag's antlers.
descriptions: Painted by Pisanello around 1438-1442
Tempera on wood, small panel measuring 54 x 65 cm
Forest wildlife depicted with the precision of naturalist studies
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Pisanello was also famous as a medalist of the Renaissance

madonna-rose-bower.title: Madonna of the Rose Bower
madonna-rose-bower.description: This Virgin of the Cologne school sits in an enclosed garden strewn with roses, symbol of her purity.
descriptions: Painted by Stefan Lochner around 1440-1442
Oil on wood, small intimate panel measuring 51 x 40 cm
Major work of the Cologne school of painting in the 15th century
Preserved at the Wallraf-Richartz Museum in Cologne
The rose symbolizes Mary's purity in medieval iconography

villeneuve-pieta.title: Pietà of Villeneuve-lès-Avignon
villeneuve-pieta.description: Against a gold ground, the angular faces and restrained grief make this Pietà one of the masterpieces of French medieval painting.
descriptions: Painted by Enguerrand Quarton around 1455-1460
Tempera and gold on wood for the Villeneuve-lès-Avignon charterhouse
Angular faces contrasting with the Byzantine gold background
Preserved at the Louvre Museum since 1905
Undisputed peak of medieval French painting

mona-lisa.title: Mona Lisa
mona-lisa.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
mona-lisa.description: The most famous enigmatic smile in the world, this portrait has become the icon of Western painting.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1503 and 1519
Oil on poplar wood measuring 77 x 53 cm
Stolen in 1911 by Vincenzo Peruggia, recovered in Florence in 1913
Displayed at the Louvre Museum behind bulletproof glass
The most visited work in the world, seen by 30,000 people per day

last-supper.title: The Last Supper
last-supper.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
last-supper.description: This fresco depicts Jesus's last meal with his apostles, the moment he announces that one of them will betray him.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1495 and 1498
Experimental oil technique, not a true fresco
Measures 4.6 meters by 8.8 meters on the refectory wall
Visible at Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan, by mandatory reservation
Restored over 21 years between 1978 and 1999

vitruvian-man.title: Vitruvian Man
vitruvian-man.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
vitruvian-man.description: This drawing illustrates the ideal proportions of the human body according to the Roman architect Vitruvius.
descriptions: Drawn by Leonardo da Vinci around 1490
Ink and wash on paper, dimensions 34 x 24 cm
Illustrates human proportions according to Vitruvius, a Roman architect
Preserved at the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice
Too fragile for permanent display, shown a few weeks per decade

lady-ermine.title: Lady with an Ermine
lady-ermine.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
lady-ermine.description: Portrait of Cecilia Gallerani, mistress of the Duke of Milan, holding an ermine — symbol of purity.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1489 and 1491
Oil on wood depicting Cecilia Gallerani at age 16
The ermine refers to Ludovico Sforza, nicknamed Ermellino
Preserved at the Czartoryski Museum in Krakow, Poland
Acquired by the Czartoryskis in 1798, saved from the Nazis during the war

virgin-rocks.title: Virgin of the Rocks
virgin-rocks.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
virgin-rocks.description: Mysterious scene in a grotto with the Virgin, the infant Jesus, Saint John the Baptist, and an angel.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci, first version around 1483-1486
Oil on wood transferred to canvas, 199 x 122 cm
Two versions exist, in Paris and London
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Revolutionary pyramidal composition for its time

sistine-ceiling.title: Sistine Chapel Ceiling
sistine-ceiling.description: Fresco including the Creation of Adam, painted lying on scaffolding for four years.
descriptions: Painted by Michelangelo between 1508 and 1512 for Julius II
Fresco covering 500 m² of the Sistine Chapel ceiling
Depicts nine Genesis scenes between prophets and sibyls
Visible at the Vatican Museums in Rome, no photos allowed
Michelangelo painted standing on scaffolds, not lying down

creation-adam.title: The Creation of Adam
creation-adam.description: The fingers of God and Adam nearly touching have become one of the most reproduced images in the history of art.
descriptions: Painted by Michelangelo between 1511 and 1512
Central fresco of the Sistine Chapel ceiling
The nearly touching fingers became the most iconic image
Visible at the Vatican Museums in Rome
The drapery surrounding God evokes the anatomical shape of the human brain

last-judgment.title: The Last Judgment
last-judgment.description: This monumental fresco depicts the return of Christ and the final judgment of humanity.
descriptions: Painted by Michelangelo between 1536 and 1541 for Paul III
Giant fresco of 13.7 x 12 meters on the Sistine altar wall
Over 300 figures including Michelangelo as flayed skin
Visible in the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican
Daniele da Volterra added veils to nudes in 1565, nicknamed 'Braghettone'

david-michelangelo.title: David
david-michelangelo.description: Carved from an abandoned block of marble, this 5-meter statue depicts the biblical hero before his fight against Goliath.
descriptions: Sculpted by Michelangelo between 1501 and 1504
Carrara marble measuring 5.17 meters tall
Made from a block abandoned by other sculptors
Preserved at the Galleria dell'Accademia in Florence since 1873
Originally intended for the cathedral, placed in Piazza della Signoria

pieta.title: The Pietà
pieta.description: The only work signed by Michelangelo, depicting the Virgin holding the body of Christ.
descriptions: Sculpted by Michelangelo between 1498 and 1499
Carrara marble, 1.74 meters tall
The only work signed by Michelangelo, on Mary's sash
Visible at St. Peter's Basilica in the Vatican, behind bulletproof glass
Damaged by a fanatic in 1972, restored and now protected

school-athens.title: The School of Athens
school-athens.description: This fresco gathers the greatest philosophers of antiquity, with Plato and Aristotle at the center.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael between 1509 and 1511 for Julius II
Fresco in the Room of the Signatura in the papal apartments
Brings together Plato, Aristotle, Pythagoras, Euclid and other philosophers
Visible at the Vatican Museums in Rome
Raphael depicted himself on the right, in a black hat

sistine-madonna.title: Sistine Madonna
sistine-madonna.description: The two cherubs at the bottom of the painting have become one of the most reproduced motifs of Western art.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael around 1513-1514 for the church of San Sisto
Oil on canvas measuring 2.65 x 1.96 meters
The two cherubs at the bottom have inspired millions of postcards since 1800
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden
Saved from bombs by the Soviets in 1945, returned in 1955

transfiguration.title: The Transfiguration
transfiguration.description: Raphael's last work, unfinished at his death, considered his masterpiece.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael between 1516 and 1520
Oil on wood measuring 4.1 x 2.8 meters
Left unfinished at Raphael's death at age 37
Preserved at the Vatican Pinacoteca in the Vatican Museums
Placed at his bedside during his funeral according to tradition

birth-venus.title: The Birth of Venus
birth-venus.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
birth-venus.description: Venus emerging from the sea on a shell has become the icon of Renaissance ideal beauty.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli around 1485 for the Medici
Tempera on canvas measuring 1.72 x 2.78 meters
One of the first large canvases in the history of Western art
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Venus strikes the antique pose of the Greco-Roman Venus Pudica

primavera.title: Primavera
primavera.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
primavera.description: A complex allegory celebrating love and spring renewal through mythological figures.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli around 1480 for Lorenzo il Magnifico
Tempera on wood measuring 2.03 x 3.14 meters
Over 500 plant species identified in the meadow
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Mythological allegory of spring inspired by ancient poems

venus-urbino.title: Venus of Urbino
venus-urbino.description: This female nude influenced generations of artists, from Goya to Manet.
descriptions: Painted by Titian in 1538 for the Duke of Urbino
Oil on canvas measuring 1.19 x 1.65 meters
Reimagined by Manet in 1863 in his scandalous Olympia
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Mark Twain called it 'the foulest in the world'

assumption-virgin.title: Assumption of the Virgin
assumption-virgin.description: Monumental depiction of Mary's elevation to heaven, a masterpiece of Venetian color.
descriptions: Painted by Titian between 1516 and 1518
Oil on wood, immense panel of 6.9 x 3.6 meters
Titian's first major masterpiece at age 28
Still visible at the Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari basilica in Venice
Revolutionary composition with dramatic ascending movement

bacchus-ariadne.title: Bacchus and Ariadne
bacchus-ariadne.description: Mythological scene where Bacchus leaps from his chariot to join Ariadne.
descriptions: Painted by Titian between 1520 and 1523 for Alfonso I d'Este
Oil on canvas measuring 1.76 x 1.91 meters
Ultramarine blue sky, a pigment more precious than gold
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Inspired by the poems of Catullus and Ovid

arnolfini-portrait.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
arnolfini-portrait.description: This double portrait is famous for its convex mirror and complex matrimonial symbolism.
descriptions: Painted by Jan van Eyck in 1434
Oil on oak wood measuring 82 x 60 cm
The convex mirror on the wall reflects two witnesses, including the painter
Preserved at the National Gallery in London since 1842
Signature 'Johannes de Eyck fuit hic 1434' above the mirror

ghent-altarpiece.title: Ghent Altarpiece
ghent-altarpiece.description: Monumental polyptych considered one of the masterpieces of Western painting.
descriptions: Painted by Jan van Eyck and his brother Hubert, completed in 1432
Polyptych with 12 panels, opened and closed according to feasts
Stolen, dismembered, saved several times, including by the Monuments Men
Visible at Saint Bavo Cathedral in Ghent, Belgium
A panel of the Just Judges has remained missing since 1934

man-red-turban.title: Portrait of a Man in a Red Turban
man-red-turban.description: Probably a self-portrait of the artist, with direct gaze and scarlet turban.
descriptions: Painted by Jan van Eyck in 1433
Oil on wood measuring 25.5 x 19 cm, small intimate format
Probably the oldest self-portrait in Western history
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Signature and motto 'Als ik kan' (as best I can)

madonna-chancellor-rolin.title: Virgin of Chancellor Rolin
madonna-chancellor-rolin.description: The Chancellor of Burgundy kneels before the Virgin in a loggia opening onto a landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Jan van Eyck around 1435 for Nicolas Rolin
Oil on wood measuring 66 x 62 cm
More than 70 miniature figures discernible in the landscape
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Rolin was the powerful chancellor of the Duke of Burgundy

garden-earthly-delights.title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
garden-earthly-delights.description: Enigmatic triptych depicting paradise, earthly pleasures, and hell.
descriptions: Painted by Hieronymus Bosch between 1490 and 1510
Oil on wood, triptych measuring 2.2 x 3.9 meters when open
Hundreds of whimsical figures in enigmatic scenes
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid since 1939
When opened and closed, it tells of paradise, pleasures and damnation

temptation-st-anthony-bosch.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
temptation-st-anthony-bosch.description: Triptych populated with demonic creatures tormenting the hermit saint.
descriptions: Painted by Hieronymus Bosch around 1501
Oil on wood, triptych measuring 1.3 x 2.3 meters when open
Saint Anthony assailed by whimsical demonic creatures
Preserved at the Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga in Lisbon
Stolen in 1888, recovered then classified as a Portuguese national treasure

haywain-bosch.title: The Haywain Triptych
haywain-bosch.description: Allegory of human greed, with humanity fighting over a cart of hay.
descriptions: Painted by Hieronymus Bosch around 1516
Oil on wood, triptych inspired by a Flemish proverb
The hay wagon symbolizes vain earthly pleasures
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Philip II of Spain, a great Bosch collector, acquired it in 1570

durer-self-portrait.title: Self-Portrait with Fur-Trimmed Robe
durer-self-portrait.description: Dürer depicts himself frontally, in an almost Christ-like pose, asserting the artist's status.
descriptions: Painted by Albrecht Dürer in 1500, at age 28
Oil on limewood measuring 67 x 49 cm
Frontal pose previously reserved for Christ in religious art
Preserved at the Alte Pinakothek in Munich
Boldly asserts the divine status of creative genius

four-apostles.title: The Four Apostles
four-apostles.description: Dürer's artistic testament, depicting John, Peter, Mark, and Paul.
descriptions: Painted by Albrecht Dürer in 1526
Oil on wood, diptych of two panels 2.15 meters tall
Donated by Dürer to his hometown of Nuremberg
Preserved at the Alte Pinakothek in Munich since 1627
Considered Dürer's artistic and spiritual testament

ambassadors.title: The Ambassadors
ambassadors.description: Double portrait famous for its anamorphic skull in the foreground.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Holbein the Younger in 1533
Oil on oak wood measuring 2.07 x 2.1 meters
Anamorphic skull visible only when viewed from the side
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Scattered objects secretly encode the religious turmoil of the era

henry-viii-holbein.title: Portrait of Henry VIII
henry-viii-holbein.description: Iconic portrait of the King of England in a frontal pose of power.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Holbein the Younger around 1537
Oil on wood depicting the king in a frontal, menacing pose
Official image reproduced and circulated throughout the kingdom
Preserved at the Walker Art Gallery in Liverpool
Holbein was the official painter of the Tudor court

erasmus-holbein.title: Portrait of Erasmus of Rotterdam
erasmus-holbein.description: The great humanist depicted writing, symbol of Renaissance thought.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Holbein the Younger around 1523
Oil on wood depicting the humanist in profile
Erasmus holds a quill, writing his Paraphrases of the New Testament
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Holbein gave this portrait to Thomas More, Erasmus's friend

man-blue-sleeve.title: Man with a Glove
man-blue-sleeve.description: Portrait of a young Venetian aristocrat, a masterpiece of psychology.
descriptions: Painted by Titian around 1510, his youthful masterpiece
Oil on canvas depicting a young Venetian aristocrat
The quilted satin sleeve is a pinnacle of pictorial virtuosity
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Pose and gaze inspired Rembrandt for his 1640 self-portrait

charles-v-muhlberg.title: Equestrian Portrait of Charles V
charles-v-muhlberg.description: The emperor in armor after his victory at Mühlberg.
descriptions: Painted by Titian in 1548 after the victory of Mühlberg
Oil on canvas measuring 3.32 x 2.79 meters
First major solemn equestrian portrait in modern painting
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Charles V appears in defeated Protestant armor

flora-titian.title: Flora
flora-titian.description: Allegorical portrait of a young woman as the goddess of spring.
descriptions: Painted by Titian around 1515-1517
Oil on canvas depicting a woman holding flowers
Model possibly Titian's mistress or wife
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Influenced idealized female nudes for the next three centuries

noli-me-tangere.title: Noli me tangere
noli-me-tangere.description: The risen Christ appears to Mary Magdalene in the garden.
descriptions: Painted by Titian around 1514
Oil on canvas measuring 1.1 x 0.92 meters
Christ evades a distraught Mary Magdalene, a Gospel scene
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
One of the most poetic works of the young Titian

diana-actaeon.title: Diana and Actaeon
diana-actaeon.description: The hunter surprises the goddess bathing — a dramatic mythological scene.
descriptions: Painted by Titian between 1556 and 1559 for Philip II of Spain
Oil on canvas measuring 1.85 x 2.02 meters
The hunter surprises the goddess bathing, a mythological scene
Preserved by agreement between the National Galleries of London and Edinburgh
Purchased in 2009 for 50 million pounds sterling

wedding-cana.title: The Wedding at Cana
wedding-cana.description: The largest painting in the Louvre, depicting Jesus's first miracle.
descriptions: Painted by Veronese in 1563 for the convent of San Giorgio Maggiore
Oil on canvas, the largest painting in the Louvre at 67 m²
Seized by Napoleon in 1797 and brought back to Paris
Visible at the Louvre, directly opposite the Mona Lisa
Over 130 figures depicted in the biblical scene

feast-levi.title: Feast in the House of Levi
feast-levi.description: A banquet scene that earned Veronese a summons before the Inquisition.
descriptions: Painted by Veronese in 1573 for the Dominicans
Oil on canvas measuring 5.5 x 12.8 meters
The Inquisition summoned Veronese over figures deemed irreverent
Preserved at the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice
Renamed Feast in the House of Levi to escape religious censorship

rape-europa-veronese.title: The Rape of Europa
rape-europa-veronese.description: Zeus disguised as a bull abducts the Phoenician princess in a luminous landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Veronese around 1580
Oil on canvas inspired by Ovid's Metamorphoses
Zeus, transformed into a bull, carries Europa away on his back
Visible at the Doge's Palace in Venice, in the Anticollegio hall
One of the painter's favorite mythological works

madonna-chair.title: Madonna of the Chair
madonna-chair.description: Tondo depicting the Virgin embracing the infant Jesus.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael around 1513-1514
Oil on wood, circular shape or tondo, 71 cm in diameter
Mary embraces the infant Jesus with Saint John the Baptist
Preserved at the Pitti Palace in Florence
One of Raphael's most reproduced works in the 19th century

portrait-baldassare.title: Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione
portrait-baldassare.description: Portrait of the author of The Book of the Courtier, Raphael's friend.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael between 1514 and 1515
Oil on canvas measuring 82 x 67 cm
Castiglione was the author of the famous Book of the Courtier
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Inspired Rembrandt for his self-portraits with crossed hands

galatea-raphael.title: The Triumph of Galatea
galatea-raphael.description: The sea nymph on a shell drawn by dolphins.
descriptions: Painted by Raphael in 1512 for Agostino Chigi
Fresco in the loggia of the Villa Farnesina in Rome
Triumphant Galatea glides over the waves pulled by dolphins
Still visible at the Villa Farnesina in Rome
Model of feminine ideal that Raphael said he invented for lack of a living model

annunciation-botticelli.title: The Annunciation
annunciation-botticelli.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
annunciation-botticelli.description: The angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will bear Christ.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli in 1489-1490
Tempera and oil on wood for the Cestello church in Florence
Virgin's recoiling gesture particularly expressive
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Light, airy composition typical of Botticelli's late style

pallas-centaur.title: Pallas and the Centaur
pallas-centaur.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
pallas-centaur.description: Allegory of wisdom triumphing over wild nature.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli around 1482 for the Medici
Tempera on canvas measuring 2.05 x 1.47 meters
Political allegory of Medici rule in Florence
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Pallas wears a dress adorned with interlaced Medici rings

venus-mars.title: Venus and Mars
venus-mars.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
venus-mars.description: Mars asleep next to a wakeful Venus — love triumphs over war.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli around 1485
Tempera and oil on wood measuring 69 x 174 cm
Little satyrs play with sleeping Mars's weapons
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Probably painted for a marriage of the Vespucci families

madonna-magnificat.title: Madonna of the Magnificat
madonna-magnificat.artistFullName: Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi
madonna-magnificat.description: Tondo of the Virgin being crowned by angels.
descriptions: Painted by Botticelli around 1481
Tempera on wood in circular shape, tondo 1.18 meters in diameter
Mary writes the Magnificat canticle, surrounded by angels
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
The tondo, a circular format, was fashionable in Florentine Renaissance

doni-tondo.title: The Holy Family (Doni Tondo)
descriptions: Painted by Michelangelo around 1507 for Agnolo Doni
Tempera on circular wood, 1.2 meters in diameter
Michelangelo's only completed panel painting
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Original frame also carved by Michelangelo, still in place

moses-michelangelo.title: Moses
moses-michelangelo.description: Monumental sculpture for the tomb of Pope Julius II.
descriptions: Sculpted by Michelangelo between 1513 and 1515
Carrara marble measuring 2.35 meters tall
Horns on the forehead from a mistranslated biblical passage
Visible in the church of San Pietro in Vincoli in Rome
According to legend, Michelangelo said 'Speak!' upon finishing the work

slaves-michelangelo.title: The Dying Slave
slaves-michelangelo.description: Unfinished figure intended for the tomb of Julius II.
descriptions: Sculpted by Michelangelo between 1513 and 1516
Carrara marble intended for Julius II's tomb
Unfinished but expressive figure even within the raw block
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris since 1794
With its counterpart the Rebellious Slave, illustrates the soul imprisoned by the body

annunciation-leonardo.title: The Annunciation
annunciation-leonardo.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
annunciation-leonardo.description: An early work by Leonardo already showing his mastery of landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1472 and 1475 at age 20
Oil and tempera on wood measuring 98 x 217 cm
Youthful work created in Verrocchio's workshop in Florence
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Leonardo's first major landscape masterpiece in perspective

adoration-magi.title: The Adoration of the Magi
adoration-magi.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
adoration-magi.description: Unfinished but revolutionary work in its composition.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci starting in 1481
Unfinished oil on wood measuring 2.46 x 2.43 meters
Leonardo left for Milan, abandoning this commission in Florence
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Revolutionary composition with pyramidal figures and perspective

st-john-baptist.title: Saint John the Baptist
st-john-baptist.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
st-john-baptist.description: Leonardo's last painting, with an enigmatic smile.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1508 and 1519
Oil on walnut wood measuring 69 x 57 cm
Leonardo's last painting, completed in Amboise, France
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Mysterious smile comparable to that of the Mona Lisa

belle-ferronniere.title: La Belle Ferronnière
belle-ferronniere.artistFullName: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
belle-ferronniere.description: Portrait of a lady of the Milanese court.
descriptions: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci around 1490-1496
Oil on wood likely depicting Lucrezia Crivelli
Mistress of Ludovico Sforza, Duke of Milan
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
An American copy sold for 1.5 million dollars in 2010

assumption-correggio.title: Assumption of the Virgin
assumption-correggio.description: Illusionistic dome showing Mary rising to heaven.
descriptions: Painted by Correggio between 1526 and 1530
Fresco in the dome of Parma Cathedral
First monumental example of ceiling illusionism
Still visible at Parma Cathedral in Italy
Criticized at the time as 'stew of frog thighs'

jupiter-io.title: Jupiter and Io
jupiter-io.description: Jupiter in the form of a cloud embraces the nymph Io.
descriptions: Painted by Correggio around 1530 for Federico II of Mantua
Oil on canvas measuring 1.63 x 0.74 meters
Jupiter as a cloud embraces the nymph Io, a sensual scene
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Censored and cut by a cardinal in the 17th century, restored since

noli-me-tangere-correggio.title: Noli me tangere
noli-me-tangere-correggio.description: The risen Christ appears to Mary Magdalene in a bucolic landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Correggio around 1525
Oil on wood transferred to canvas, 130 x 103 cm
Risen Christ appears to Mary Magdalene in a garden
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Acquired by Philip IV of Spain in the 17th century

annunciation-angelico.title: The Annunciation
annunciation-angelico.description: A fresco of spiritual purity in the convent of San Marco.
descriptions: Painted by Fra Angelico around 1438-1445 at the San Marco convent
Fresco at the top of the convent's grand staircase
Geometric purity serving Dominican spirituality
Still visible at the San Marco Museum in Florence
Fra Angelico was beatified by John Paul II in 1982

coronation-virgin-angelico.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
coronation-virgin-angelico.description: The Virgin crowned by Christ surrounded by a heavenly court in brilliant colors.
descriptions: Painted by Fra Angelico around 1430-1432
Tempera and gold on wood, monumental altarpiece
Heavenly court in bright colors typical of the painter
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Fra Angelico was a Dominican friar painter

deposition-angelico.title: Deposition from the Cross
deposition-angelico.description: An altarpiece surprisingly gentle for such a dramatic subject.
descriptions: Painted by Fra Angelico around 1432-1434
Tempera on wood for the sacristy of Santa Trinita in Florence
Dramatic subject treated with serene gentleness
Preserved at the San Marco Museum in Florence
Begun by Lorenzo Monaco, completed by Fra Angelico

flagellation-christ.title: The Flagellation of Christ
flagellation-christ.description: Enigmatic composition in which the flagellation takes place in the background.
descriptions: Painted by Piero della Francesca around 1455-1470
Tempera and oil on wood measuring 58 x 81 cm
Three foreground figures still unidentified
Preserved at the Galleria Nazionale delle Marche in Urbino
Considered 'the greatest small painting in the world'

duke-urbino.title: Portraits of the Dukes of Urbino
duke-urbino.description: Double portrait of Federico da Montefeltro and his wife.
descriptions: Painted by Piero della Francesca around 1465-1472
Diptych in oil on wood, 47 x 33 cm each
Federico in profile hiding an eye lost in a tournament
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
On the reverse, triumphal allegories of their virtues

resurrection-piero.title: The Resurrection
resurrection-piero.description: The triumphant Christ rises from the tomb — called the greatest painting in the world by Huxley.
descriptions: Painted by Piero della Francesca around 1463-1465
Fresco in the council hall of Borgo Sansepolcro
Saved during World War II by a British officer who had read Huxley
Still visible at the Museo Civico in Sansepolcro
Aldous Huxley called it 'the greatest painting in the world'

lamentation-christ.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ
lamentation-christ.description: A bold foreshortening showing Christ seen from his feet.
descriptions: Painted by Mantegna around 1480-1483
Tempera on canvas measuring 68 x 81 cm
Revolutionary anatomical foreshortening of Christ seen from his feet
Preserved at the Pinacoteca di Brera in Milan
Found in Mantegna's studio at his death in 1506

camera-sposi.title: Camera degli Sposi
camera-sposi.description: First example of trompe-l'œil on a ceiling in modern painting.
descriptions: Painted by Mantegna between 1465 and 1474 for the Gonzaga family
Frescoes entirely decorating a room of the ducal palace
First trompe-l'œil on a ceiling simulating an open sky
Visible at the Palazzo Ducale in Mantua, Italy
Mantegna painted the Gonzaga family there as a group portrait

agony-garden-mantegna.title: The Agony in the Garden
agony-garden-mantegna.description: Christ at prayer on the Mount of Olives in a meticulously detailed rocky landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Mantegna around 1455-1456
Tempera on wood measuring 63 x 80 cm
Rocky landscape of astonishing geological precision
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Mantegna's brother-in-law, Giovanni Bellini, treated the same subject

sleeping-venus.title: Sleeping Venus
sleeping-venus.description: First major reclining female nude in Venetian painting.
descriptions: Painted by Giorgione around 1508-1510
Oil on canvas measuring 1.08 x 1.75 meters
First major reclining female nude in Western art
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden
Completed by Titian after Giorgione's premature death

tempest-giorgione.title: The Tempest
tempest-giorgione.description: An enigmatic landscape whose subject remains a mystery, founding work of Venetian landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Giorgione around 1505-1508
Oil on canvas measuring 82 x 73 cm
Subject still mysterious: nursing woman and soldier in a storm
Preserved at the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice
First autonomous landscape in Western painting

three-philosophers.title: The Three Philosophers
three-philosophers.description: Three thinkers in front of a cave, an allegory of the ages of knowledge.
descriptions: Painted by Giorgione around 1508-1509
Oil on canvas measuring 1.23 x 1.44 meters
Three ages of philosophy: Eastern, elderly Eastern, and young Greek
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Enigmatic work with multiple interpretations still debated

last-supper-tintoretto.title: The Last Supper
last-supper-tintoretto.description: Dramatic and luminous vision of Christ's final meal.
descriptions: Painted by Tintoretto between 1592 and 1594
Oil on canvas measuring 3.65 x 5.68 meters
Dynamic vision in radically oblique perspective
Visible at the basilica of San Giorgio Maggiore in Venice
Tintoretto's last masterpiece before his death in 1594

paradise-tintoretto.title: Paradise
paradise-tintoretto.description: The largest painting on canvas in the world, depicting Paradise.
descriptions: Painted by Tintoretto with his workshop between 1588 and 1592
Largest painting on canvas in the world: 7.45 x 24.65 meters
Over 500 figures depicted in Paradise
Visible at the Doge's Palace in Venice, in the Great Council Hall
Tintoretto got the contract at age 70 despite competition from Veronese

miracle-slave-tintoretto.title: Miracle of the Slave
miracle-slave-tintoretto.description: Saint Mark plunges from heaven to save a slave — dynamism and Venetian colors.
descriptions: Painted by Tintoretto in 1548 for the Scuola Grande di San Marco
Oil on canvas measuring 4.16 x 5.44 meters
Saint Mark dives from the sky to save the slave
Preserved at the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice
Work that established Tintoretto's fame at age 30

last-judgment-memling.title: The Last Judgment
last-judgment-memling.description: Monumental triptych of the Last Judgment with meticulous detail.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Memling between 1467 and 1471
Oil on wood, triptych measuring 2.2 x 3.2 meters when open
Seized by pirates at sea while being shipped to Florence
Preserved at the Muzeum Narodowe in Gdańsk, Poland
Commissioned by Angelo Tani, Medici agent in Bruges

portrait-young-woman-memling.title: Portrait of a Young Woman
portrait-young-woman-memling.description: Intimate portrait of a Bruges bourgeoise.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Memling around 1470
Oil on wood measuring 44 x 34 cm
Depicts Maria Portinari, wife of a Florentine banker settled in Bruges
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Memling trained under Rogier van der Weyden in Brussels

triptych-donne-memling.title: The Donne Triptych
triptych-donne-memling.description: Devotional triptych commissioned by a Welsh diplomat at the Burgundian court.
descriptions: Painted by Hans Memling around 1478
Oil on wood, triptych commissioned by Sir John Donne of Kidwelly
Welsh diplomat depicted kneeling with his family
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Mary holds the Child between Saints Catherine and Barbara

descent-cross-weyden.title: Descent from the Cross
descent-cross-weyden.description: Masterpiece of restrained emotion and composition.
descriptions: Painted by Rogier van der Weyden around 1435
Oil on wood measuring 2.2 x 2.62 meters
Ten figures compressed in a reduced space, intense emotion
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Fainting Mary mirrors the pose of dead Christ, a dramatic echo

last-judgment-weyden.title: The Last Judgment
last-judgment-weyden.description: Monumental polyptych commissioned by Chancellor Rolin for the Beaune hospice.
descriptions: Painted by Rogier van der Weyden around 1445-1450
Polyptych of 15 panels in oil on wood
Commissioned by Nicolas Rolin for the Hospices of Beaune
Still visible at the Hospices of Beaune in Burgundy
Saint Michael weighing souls dominates the central composition

portrait-lady-weyden.title: Portrait of a Lady
portrait-lady-weyden.description: Portrait of austere elegance with white headdress and transparent veil.
descriptions: Painted by Rogier van der Weyden around 1460
Oil on wood measuring 37 x 27 cm
The lady's identity is unknown but likely Burgundian
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Transparent veil and white headdress typical of Burgundy

hunters-snow.title: Hunters in the Snow
hunters-snow.description: Panoramic winter landscape with hunters returning to the village.
descriptions: Painted by Bruegel the Elder in 1565
Oil on wood measuring 1.17 x 1.62 meters
Part of a series of Months now dispersed
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Depicts February during the 'Little Ice Age' that struck Europe

tower-babel.title: The Tower of Babel
descriptions: Painted by Bruegel the Elder in 1563
Oil on wood measuring 1.14 x 1.55 meters
Inspired by the Colosseum of Rome that Bruegel had visited
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Three versions exist, including a smaller one in Rotterdam

peasant-wedding.title: The Peasant Wedding
peasant-wedding.description: A lively Flemish peasant feast scene.
descriptions: Painted by Bruegel the Elder around 1567
Oil on wood measuring 1.14 x 1.64 meters
Rustic banquet in a Flemish barn
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Over 30 identifiable figures in the scene

fall-icarus.title: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus
fall-icarus.description: Icarus falls unnoticed while life carries on around him.
descriptions: Attributed to Bruegel the Elder, painted around 1558
Oil on canvas measuring 73.5 x 112 cm
Icarus reduced to two legs plunging into the sea in the background
Preserved at the Royal Museums of Fine Arts in Brussels
Inspired W.H. Auden's famous poem 'Musée des Beaux-Arts'

blind-leading-blind.title: The Parable of the Blind
blind-leading-blind.description: Six blind men leading each other to their fall — sharp social criticism.
descriptions: Painted by Bruegel the Elder in 1568
Distemper on canvas measuring 86 x 154 cm
Illustrates a famous Gospel parable
Preserved at the Museo di Capodimonte in Naples
Eye diseases of the blind painted with medical precision

adam-eve-cranach.title: Adam and Eve
adam-eve-cranach.description: The primordial couple in the Garden of Eden.
descriptions: Painted by Lucas Cranach the Elder around 1526
Diptych in oil on wood for the Protestant Reformation
Cranach treated this subject in multiple versions throughout his life
Preserved at the Courtauld Gallery in London
Cranach was Martin Luther's friend and portraitist

judith-holofernes-cranach.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
judith-holofernes-cranach.description: The biblical heroine elegantly dressed, holding her gruesome prize.
descriptions: Painted by Lucas Cranach the Elder around 1530
Oil on wood depicting the biblical heroine
Elegantly holds the severed head of the enemy general
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Cranach painted the subject in several versions that became very famous

venus-cranach.title: Venus
venus-cranach.description: Mannerist female nude with a slender body and direct gaze.
descriptions: Painted by Lucas Cranach the Elder around 1532
Oil on wood depicting the goddess as a slender nude
The Mannerist body follows the German Renaissance canon
Preserved at the Städel Museum in Frankfurt
Cranach and his workshop produced dozens of similar Venuses

praying-hands.title: Praying Hands
praying-hands.description: A study of hands that became one of the most reproduced images.
descriptions: Drawn by Albrecht Dürer in 1508
Brush study in black and white ink on paper
Preparatory for an altarpiece destroyed in a 1729 fire
Preserved at the Albertina in Vienna
Became one of the most reproduced images in the world

young-hare.title: Young Hare
young-hare.description: Watercolor of rare realism for its time.
descriptions: Painted by Albrecht Dürer in 1502
Watercolor and gouache on paper measuring 25 x 22 cm
Reflection of the window visible in the hare's eye
Preserved at the Albertina in Vienna
Considered one of the first naturalistic animal paintings

melencolia.title: Melencolia I
descriptions: Engraved by Albrecht Dürer in 1514
Burin on copper measuring 24 x 19 cm
Contains a magic square whose numbers add up to 34
Original preserved at the Staatliche Kunsthalle in Karlsruhe
The year 1514 (the date of the work) appears in the magic square

adam-eve-durer.title: Adam and Eve
adam-eve-durer.description: The first humans in their original perfection.
descriptions: Painted by Albrecht Dürer in 1507
Oil on wood, diptych of 2.09 meters each
First major full-length nude in German Renaissance art
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Christina of Sweden acquired them then they passed to Philip IV

madonna-meadow-bellini.title: Madonna of the Meadow
madonna-meadow-bellini.description: The Virgin meditating on the sleeping child in a vast Venetian landscape.
descriptions: Painted by Giovanni Bellini around 1505
Oil and tempera on wood transferred to canvas, 67 x 86 cm
Mary meditates on the sleeping child, evoking the future dead Christ
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Bellini, official painter of the Republic of Venice

feast-gods-bellini.title: The Feast of the Gods
feast-gods-bellini.description: Bellini's last great work, a mythological banquet in a wood.
descriptions: Painted by Giovanni Bellini in 1514, completed by Titian
Oil on canvas measuring 1.7 x 1.88 meters
Bellini's last great work, when he was over 80 years old
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Bellini was the master of Titian and Giorgione

agony-garden-bellini.title: The Agony in the Garden
agony-garden-bellini.description: Christ at prayer in a landscape at dawn — with characteristic golden light.
descriptions: Painted by Giovanni Bellini around 1465
Tempera on wood measuring 81 x 127 cm
First light of dawn treated with atmospheric precision
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Composition inspired by his brother-in-law Mantegna

pieta-brera-bellini.title: Pietà
pieta-brera-bellini.description: The dead Christ supported by the Virgin and Saint John — restrained emotion.
descriptions: Painted by Giovanni Bellini around 1465-1470
Tempera on wood measuring 86 x 107 cm
Latin inscription at Christ's feet: a peak of pictorial emotion
Preserved at the Pinacoteca di Brera in Milan
One of the most moving works of the Venetian Renaissance

view-toledo.title: View of Toledo
view-toledo.description: An apocalyptic landscape of the city under a stormy sky, one of the first pure landscapes of Western art.
descriptions: Painted by El Greco around 1597-1599
Oil on canvas measuring 1.21 x 1.09 meters
First pure landscape in modern Western painting
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Stormy sky foreshadows the Romantic landscapes of the 19th century

burial-count-orgaz.title: The Burial of the Count of Orgaz
burial-count-orgaz.description: A masterpiece uniting the earthly and celestial worlds during a miraculous funeral.
descriptions: Painted by El Greco between 1586 and 1588
Oil on canvas measuring 4.8 x 3.6 meters
Saints Stephen and Augustine miraculously descend to bury the count
Still visible in the Santo Tomé church in Toledo
El Greco depicted himself among the noblemen present

opening-fifth-seal.title: The Opening of the Fifth Seal
opening-fifth-seal.description: A hallucinated vision of the Apocalypse, with characteristic elongated and twisted figures.
descriptions: Painted by El Greco between 1608 and 1614
Oil on canvas depicting a vision of the Apocalypse
Mannerist style with elongated and twisted figures
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Said to have inspired Picasso for Les Demoiselles d'Avignon

disrobing-christ.title: The Disrobing of Christ
disrobing-christ.description: The scarlet red of Christ's cloak dominates the compressed crowd.
descriptions: Painted by El Greco in 1579 for Toledo Cathedral
Oil on canvas measuring 2.85 x 1.73 meters
The scarlet red of Christ's cloak is the brightest in Spain
Still visible in Toledo Cathedral
El Greco's first major commission upon arriving in Spain

calling-saint-matthew.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
calling-saint-matthew.description: The shaft of divine light pointing to Matthew revolutionized the use of chiaroscuro.
descriptions: Painted by Caravaggio between 1599 and 1600
Oil on canvas measuring 3.4 x 3.22 meters
Ray of divine light points to Matthew, the tax collector
Visible in the church of San Luigi dei Francesi in Rome
Revolutionary with an invisible Jesus among card players

judith-holofernes.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
judith-holofernes.description: A scene of striking realistic violence, showing the biblical heroine in the midst of her act.
descriptions: Painted by Caravaggio around 1599
Oil on canvas measuring 1.45 x 1.95 meters
Judith beheads Holofernes with raw realism and brutal violence
Preserved at the National Gallery of Ancient Art in Rome
Holofernes's face resembles that of an angry Caravaggio

supper-emmaus.title: Supper at Emmaus
supper-emmaus.description: The risen Christ reveals himself to his disciples during a meal, captured at the moment of revelation.
descriptions: Painted by Caravaggio in 1601
Oil on canvas measuring 1.41 x 1.96 meters
Disciples recognize the risen Christ as he breaks bread
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Pilgrim's shell on the apostle, symbol of the Way of Saint James

david-goliath-caravaggio.title: David with the Head of Goliath
david-goliath-caravaggio.description: Self-portrait of Caravaggio as the beheaded Goliath, painted while he was fleeing a death sentence.
descriptions: Painted by Caravaggio around 1610
Oil on canvas measuring 1.25 x 1.01 meters
Self-portrait of Caravaggio as the beheaded Goliath
Preserved at the Borghese Gallery in Rome
Painted to obtain papal pardon, as the painter was sentenced to death

bacchus-caravaggio.title: Bacchus
bacchus-caravaggio.description: The god of wine depicted as a sensual young man offering a cup of wine.
descriptions: Painted by Caravaggio around 1596
Oil on canvas measuring 95 x 85 cm
Small self-portrait of the painter visible in the glass carafe
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Found in the Uffizi storerooms in the early 20th century

night-watch.title: The Night Watch
night-watch.description: This revolutionary group portrait shows a militia in motion rather than posing statically.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1642 for the Amsterdam civic militia
Oil on canvas, original format 3.87 x 5.02 meters
Cut down in 1715 to fit through a door, panels lost since
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam in a dedicated room
Currently being publicly restored, visible to viewers since 2019

anatomy-lesson.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Tulp
anatomy-lesson.description: Group portrait depicting a public dissection — a common practice in the 17th century.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1632 at age 26
Oil on canvas measuring 1.69 x 2.16 meters
Painting that launched Rembrandt in Amsterdam
Preserved at the Mauritshuis in The Hague
The corpse is an executed criminal, authorized through public dissection

return-prodigal-son.title: Return of the Prodigal Son
return-prodigal-son.description: A late work imbued with compassion, depicting the biblical parable of paternal forgiveness.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt around 1668, two years before his death
Oil on canvas measuring 2.62 x 2.06 meters
Work of spiritual maturity, painted with much impasto
Preserved at the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg
Favorite subject of theologian Henri Nouwen who wrote a famous book about it

jewish-bride.title: The Jewish Bride
jewish-bride.description: Van Gogh admired this painting so much he said he would give ten years of his life to contemplate it.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt around 1665-1669
Oil on canvas measuring 1.21 x 1.66 meters
Couple identified as Isaac and Rebecca according to tradition
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam
Van Gogh said he would give ten years of his life to contemplate it at length

self-portrait-rembrandt-63.title: Self-Portrait with Two Circles
self-portrait-rembrandt-63.description: One of Rembrandt's many self-portraits, an introspective record of his old age.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1665, at age 59
Oil on canvas measuring 1.14 x 0.94 meters
Two perfect circles visible behind him remain enigmatic
Preserved at Kenwood House in London
Rembrandt painted more than 80 self-portraits during his life

girl-pearl-earring.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
girl-pearl-earring.description: Nicknamed the 'Mona Lisa of the North,' this tronie captivates with her mysterious gaze and luminous pearl.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1665
Oil on canvas measuring 44.5 x 39 cm
Purchased for two florins in 1881 at an auction
Preserved at the Mauritshuis in The Hague
Inspired a novel and then a successful film in 2003

milkmaid.title: The Milkmaid
milkmaid.description: A plain domestic scene that gives dignity to everyday work.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1657-1660
Oil on canvas measuring 45.5 x 41 cm
Dutch tiling with a discreet little Cupid on the wall
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam
Vermeer produced only 34 works now attributed to him

art-of-painting.title: The Art of Painting
art-of-painting.description: An allegory of art that Vermeer kept until his death, considering it his masterpiece.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1666
Oil on canvas measuring 1.2 x 1 meter
Vermeer kept it until his death, considering it his masterpiece
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Hitler had acquired it, returned to Austria after 1945

girl-reading-letter.title: Girl Reading a Letter at an Open Window
girl-reading-letter.description: The light from the window illuminates an intimate scene of love correspondence.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1657-1659
Oil on canvas measuring 83 x 65 cm
Restoration in 2021 revealed a Cupid hidden under overpaints
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden
The Cupid transforms the scene into an allegory of true love

las-meninas.title: Las Meninas
las-meninas.artistFullName: Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez
las-meninas.description: A dizzying mise en abyme in which the painter depicts himself painting the king and queen, visible in a mirror.
descriptions: Painted by Velázquez in 1656
Oil on canvas measuring 3.18 x 2.76 meters
Velázquez paints himself painting the king and queen
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Picasso painted 58 variations of it in 1957

surrender-breda.title: The Surrender of Breda
surrender-breda.artistFullName: Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez
surrender-breda.description: An elegant depiction of the Spanish victory, showing the magnanimity of the victor.
descriptions: Painted by Velázquez between 1634 and 1635
Oil on canvas measuring 3.07 x 3.67 meters
Justin of Nassau hands over the keys of Breda to Ambrosio Spinola
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Depicts the Spanish victory of 1625 during the Eighty Years' War

rokeby-venus.title: The Rokeby Venus
rokeby-venus.artistFullName: Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez
rokeby-venus.description: Velázquez's only female nude, depicting Venus from behind contemplating her reflection.
descriptions: Painted by Velázquez around 1647-1651
Oil on canvas measuring 1.22 x 1.77 meters
Velázquez's only surviving female nude
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Slashed by suffragette Mary Richardson in 1914, restored since

descent-cross-rubens.title: The Descent from the Cross
descent-cross-rubens.description: Monumental triptych celebrated for its movement and strong colors.
descriptions: Painted by Rubens between 1611 and 1614
Oil on wood, triptych for Antwerp Cathedral
Has remained in its original location for over 400 years
Visible at the Cathedral of Our Lady in Antwerp
Théodore Géricault called this triptych the best painting in the world

rape-daughters-leucippus.title: The Rape of the Daughters of Leucippus
rape-daughters-leucippus.description: Whirling composition typical of Rubens's Baroque style.
descriptions: Painted by Rubens around 1618
Oil on canvas measuring 2.24 x 2.1 meters
Castor and Pollux abduct the daughters of King Leucippus
Preserved at the Alte Pinakothek in Munich
Swirling composition typical of Flemish Baroque

three-graces-rubens.title: The Three Graces
three-graces-rubens.description: Sensual celebration of female beauty according to Rubens's canons.
descriptions: Painted by Rubens around 1635
Oil on wood measuring 2.21 x 1.81 meters
Models inspired by his second wife Hélène Fourment
Preserved at the Prado Museum in Madrid
Rubens gave the name 'Rubenesque' to buxom women

judith-maidservant.title: Judith and Her Maidservant
judith-maidservant.description: One of the few recognized female painters of the Baroque era, known for her powerful heroines.
descriptions: Painted by Artemisia Gentileschi around 1613-1614
Oil on canvas depicting the aftermath of the beheading
Artemisia was one of the few recognized female painters of the Baroque
Preserved at the Pitti Palace in Florence
First woman admitted to the Accademia delle Arti del Disegno

judith-holofernes-gentileschi.title: Judith Slaying Holofernes
judith-holofernes-gentileschi.description: A fierce and realistic version of the biblical scene, with deliberate violence.
descriptions: Painted by Artemisia Gentileschi around 1620
Oil on canvas measuring 1.99 x 1.62 meters
Bold, visceral violence rarely seen before
Preserved at the Uffizi Gallery in Florence
Work linked to her rape trial against Agostino Tassi

susanna-elders-gentileschi.title: Susanna and the Elders
susanna-elders-gentileschi.description: Artemisia's earliest known work, painted when she was only 17.
descriptions: Painted by Artemisia Gentileschi in 1610, at age 17
Oil on canvas measuring 1.7 x 1.21 meters
Artemisia's first signed, dated, and preserved work
Preserved in the Schönborn Collection in Pommersfelden, Germany
Susanna is depicted with true repulsion toward the elders

ecstasy-saint-teresa.title: Ecstasy of Saint Teresa
ecstasy-saint-teresa.description: A masterpiece of Baroque sculpture, blending spirituality and sensuality.
descriptions: Sculpted by Bernini between 1647 and 1652
White marble in a theatrical architectural setting
Saint Teresa in ecstasy pierced by the divine arrow
Visible in the Cornaro chapel of Santa Maria della Vittoria in Rome
Stendhal experienced intense emotion there, later named Stendhal syndrome

apollo-daphne.title: Apollo and Daphne
apollo-daphne.description: The marble captures Daphne's transformation into a laurel tree.
descriptions: Sculpted by Bernini between 1622 and 1625
Carrara marble measuring 2.43 meters tall
Daphne in mid-metamorphosis into a laurel before our eyes
Preserved at the Borghese Gallery in Rome
Created by Bernini between ages 24 and 26 only

rape-proserpina-bernini.title: The Rape of Proserpina
rape-proserpina-bernini.description: Pluto's fingers sink into Proserpina's flesh, carved in marble.
descriptions: Sculpted by Bernini between 1621 and 1622
Carrara marble measuring 2.55 meters tall
Pluto's fingers sink into Proserpina's flesh
Preserved at the Borghese Gallery in Rome
Completed by Bernini at just 23 years old

david-bernini.title: David
david-bernini.description: David caught mid-action as he hurls the stone, with focused face and tensed body.
descriptions: Sculpted by Bernini between 1623 and 1624
Carrara marble measuring 1.7 meters tall
Captures David in mid-motion, ready to launch his stone
Preserved at the Borghese Gallery in Rome
The face is a self-portrait of Bernini at 25

view-delft.title: View of Delft
view-delft.description: Panoramic view of his hometown, considered by Proust the most beautiful painting in the world.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1660-1661
Oil on canvas measuring 96.5 x 115 cm
Proust called it the most beautiful painting in the world in In Search of Lost Time
Preserved at the Mauritshuis in The Hague
Vermeer never left Delft, his hometown

little-street.title: The Little Street
little-street.description: An intimate street scene, one of Vermeer's only outdoor landscapes.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1657-1658
Oil on canvas measuring 54.3 x 44 cm
One of Vermeer's rare exterior views
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam
Identified in 2015 as the house of Vermeer's aunt

astronomer.title: The Astronomer
astronomer.description: A scholar studying a celestial globe in the light of a window.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer in 1668
Oil on canvas measuring 51 x 45 cm
Celestial globe signed Jodocus Hondius dated 1600
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris since 1983
Looted by the Nazis during World War II, returned in 1945

geographer.title: The Geographer
geographer.description: Companion piece to The Astronomer, depicting a cartographer at work.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer in 1669
Oil on canvas measuring 53 x 47 cm
Complementary counterpart to the Astronomer painted the previous year
Preserved at the Städel Museum in Frankfurt
Cartographer at work in the light of a window

lacemaker.title: The Lacemaker
lacemaker.description: A small painting focused on a young woman absorbed in her work.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1669-1671
Oil on canvas mounted on wood measuring 24 x 21 cm
Vermeer's smallest painting, intimate format
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Purchased by Napoleon III in 1870 for the Louvre

woman-balance.title: Woman Holding a Balance
woman-balance.description: Allegory of the Last Judgment with a woman weighing jewels.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1664
Oil on canvas measuring 39.7 x 35.5 cm
Last Judgment painting hanging in the background
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Pregnant woman according to 17th-century Dutch fashion

music-lesson.title: The Music Lesson
music-lesson.description: Young woman playing the virginal in a room lit by the window, a man standing beside her.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1662-1665
Oil on canvas measuring 73.3 x 64.5 cm
Mirror on the wall reflects the foot of Vermeer's easel
Preserved in the Royal Collection in London
Acquired by George III in 1762, never deaccessioned

glass-wine.title: The Glass of Wine
glass-wine.description: A scene of seduction with a man serving wine to a woman.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1658-1660
Oil on canvas measuring 67.7 x 79.6 cm
Stained glass with figure of Temperance discreetly present
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie in Berlin
Subtle seduction scene in a bourgeois interior

woman-pearl-necklace.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace
woman-pearl-necklace.description: A woman admiring her necklace in the light of the window.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1664
Oil on canvas measuring 51.2 x 45.1 cm
Woman admiring herself in a small mirror by the window
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie in Berlin
Vermeer loved painting light on pearls, a recurring motif

woman-lute.title: Woman with a Lute
woman-lute.description: A musician tuning her instrument near the window.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1662-1664
Oil on canvas measuring 51.4 x 45.7 cm
Musician tuning her lute while looking out the window
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Acquired by the Met in 1900

love-letter.title: The Love Letter
love-letter.description: A maid bringing a letter to her mistress, who is playing the lute.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1669-1670
Oil on canvas measuring 44 x 38.5 cm
Scene viewed through a threshold, unusual perspective
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam
Stolen in 1971 in Brussels, recovered damaged

allegory-faith.title: Allegory of Faith
allegory-faith.description: Woman in a blue dress resting her foot on a globe, surrounded by religious symbols.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1670-1672
Oil on canvas measuring 1.14 x 0.89 meters
Late and atypical work by Vermeer, allegorical subject
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Vermeer had converted to Catholicism through marriage

allegory-painting.title: The Allegory of Painting
allegory-painting.description: Painter seen from behind at his easel, female model crowned with laurel in a studio.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1666
Oil on canvas measuring 1.2 x 1 meter
Also known as The Art of Painting
Preserved at the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna
Considered by Vermeer as his artistic testament

girl-red-hat.title: Girl with a Red Hat
girl-red-hat.description: Small tronie of a young woman with a mischievous gaze.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1665-1667
Oil on wood, exceptionally small: 23 x 18 cm
Effect of light on the bright red hat
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Vermeer probably used an optical camera obscura

woman-writing.title: A Lady Writing a Letter
woman-writing.description: A woman caught in the privacy of her correspondence.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1665
Oil on canvas measuring 45 x 39.9 cm
Woman caught mid-correspondence, looking at the viewer
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Pearl earrings, a recurring motif in Vermeer's work

mistress-maid.title: Mistress and Maid
mistress-maid.description: A maid hands a letter to her mistress.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1666-1667
Oil on canvas measuring 90 x 78 cm
Maid interrupts her mistress to hand her a letter
Preserved at the Frick Collection in New York
The merchant Henry Frick acquired it in 1919

girl-flute.title: Girl with a Flute
girl-flute.description: Young woman in a wide-brimmed hat and blue jacket, her gaze turned towards the viewer.
descriptions: Attributed to Vermeer or his workshop, around 1665-1675
Oil on wood measuring 20 x 17.8 cm
Attribution recently challenged by the National Gallery
Preserved at the National Gallery of Art in Washington
Possible companion to Girl with a Red Hat

diana-companions.title: Diana and Her Companions
diana-companions.description: The goddess Diana surrounded by her nymphs at the water's edge.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1653-1654
Oil on canvas measuring 97.8 x 104.6 cm
Youthful work on a mythological subject rare for Vermeer
Preserved at the Mauritshuis in The Hague
Inspired by the Caravaggesque painters of Utrecht

christ-martha-mary.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
christ-martha-mary.description: Vermeer's largest canvas, an early religious scene.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1654-1655
Oil on canvas measuring 1.58 x 1.42 meters
Vermeer's largest known canvas to date
Preserved at the Scottish National Gallery in Edinburgh
Rare religious subject in Vermeer's body of work

procuress-vermeer.title: The Procuress
procuress-vermeer.description: Tavern scene with a woman in yellow and three male figures around her.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer in 1656, at age 24
Oil on canvas measuring 1.43 x 1.3 meters
Vermeer may have depicted himself on the far left
Preserved at the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden
Vermeer's first dated and signed work

interrupted-music.title: The Music Lesson Interrupted
interrupted-music.description: A young woman interrupted in her lesson by the arrival of a letter.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1660-1661
Oil on canvas measuring 39 x 44 cm
Young woman interrupted in her lesson by the arrival of a letter
Preserved at the Frick Collection in New York
Acquired by Frick in 1901

sleeping-girl.title: A Maid Asleep
sleeping-girl.description: A maid asleep at a table — a domestic scene full of mystery.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1657
Oil on canvas measuring 87.6 x 76.5 cm
X-ray reveals a dog and a man erased in the background
Preserved at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York
Woman asleep at a table before an Oriental rug

soldier-laughing-girl.title: Officer and Laughing Girl
soldier-laughing-girl.description: A striking contrast between the dark soldier and the radiant woman.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1657
Oil on canvas measuring 50.5 x 46 cm
Map of Holland on the wall, bold depth effect
Preserved at the Frick Collection in New York
Acquired by Frick in 1911 for 225,000 dollars

concert-vermeer.title: The Concert
concert-vermeer.description: Three musicians playing in an interior, paintings hanging on the back wall.
descriptions: Painted by Vermeer around 1664
Oil on canvas measuring 72.5 x 64.7 cm
Stolen in 1990 from the Gardner Museum in Boston, still missing
Valued at 250 million dollars, making it the most expensive stolen work
The empty frame has remained in its place at the museum

self-portrait-1629.title: Self-Portrait at Age 23
self-portrait-1629.description: Young man with a lit face emerging from the shadows, curly hair.

Oil on wood measuring 15.5 x 12.7 cm, miniature format
Tousled hair, intense gaze of an ambitious youth
Preserved at the Alte Pinakothek in Munich
First self-portrait in a long autobiographical series

self-portrait-1640.title: Self-Portrait at Age 34
self-portrait-1640.description: Rembrandt in elegant dress leaning on a parapet, a confident gaze.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1640 at age 34
Oil on canvas measuring 1.02 x 0.8 meters
Pose and costume inspired by Raphael's portrait of Castiglione
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Rembrandt at the peak of his career in Amsterdam

self-portrait-easel.title: Self-Portrait at the Easel
self-portrait-easel.description: Rembrandt depicts himself as a painter at work.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt around 1660
Oil on canvas measuring 1.11 x 0.9 meters
Rembrandt paints himself at work at age 54, palette in hand
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Financially difficult period after his bankruptcy

bathsheba-bath.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath
bathsheba-bath.description: Introspective female nude — Bathsheba holding King David's letter.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1654
Oil on canvas measuring 1.42 x 1.42 meters
Model inspired by Hendrickje Stoffels, Rembrandt's companion
Preserved at the Louvre Museum in Paris
Bathsheba hesitates, holding King David's letter

syndics-drapers.title: The Syndics of the Drapers' Guild
syndics-drapers.description: A sober and psychologically intense group portrait.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1662
Oil on canvas measuring 1.91 x 2.79 meters
Commissioned by the Amsterdam drapers' guild
Preserved at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam
Major influence on Dutch group portraits

sacrifice-isaac.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
sacrifice-isaac.description: The angel stops Abraham's arm at the last moment.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1635
Oil on canvas measuring 1.93 x 1.33 meters
Knife suspended mid-fall, captures the critical moment
Preserved at the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg
A second version exists at the Alte Pinakothek in Munich

belshazzar-feast.title: Belshazzar's Feast
belshazzar-feast.description: Divine writing appears on the wall during the feast.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt around 1635-1638
Oil on canvas measuring 1.68 x 2.09 meters
Hebrew letters on the wall traced by a divine hand
Preserved at the National Gallery in London
Rembrandt drew inspiration from a book by Rabbi Manasseh ben Israel

storm-sea-galilee.title: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee
storm-sea-galilee.description: Boat tossed by the storm on the Sea of Galilee, panicking disciples.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt in 1633
Oil on canvas measuring 1.6 x 1.28 meters
Rembrandt's only known marine landscape
Stolen in 1990 from the Gardner Museum in Boston, still missing
Rembrandt painted himself in the boat, the thirteenth figure

descent-cross-rembrandt.title: The Descent from the Cross
descent-cross-rembrandt.description: A dramatic scene inspired by Rubens, with theatrical lighting.
descriptions: Painted by Rembrandt around 1632-1633
Oil on wood inspired by Rubens
